# Marlin Server 6 release notes

Marlin Server 6 brings a new scheduler, faster exports and a cleaner plugin interface. This page lists changes and the deprecation schedule.

## Highlights

- New work-stealing scheduler (up to 2.1x throughput)
- Streaming exporter for CSV and Parquet
- Plugin API v3

## Upgrading

Back up your data directory, stop the server, install 6.0 and start it once with `--migrate`.

| Legacy exporter | 6.0 | 6.5 |
| Basic auth over HTTP | 5.8 | 6.2 |

If you maintain plugins, start porting to v3 now.
